---
title: "Counting movements"
description: "How the quality columns superseded_dep, superseded_arr, movement_dep and movement_arr tell which flight-list rows count as departures and arrivals."
---

## In one sentence

The movement columns say which rows of the flight list count as a departure
or an arrival, so that a flight cut into several tracks is counted once.

## What it needs

- The departure and destination airports of each row, and the aircraft
  address.
- The take-off and landing times, distance-circle crossings and highest
  altitude of the track's events.

## How it is computed

A departure is often cut into two tracks: a short piece on the ground at the
stand, then the flight itself. Both start at the airport.

1. **`superseded_dep`** is true when the row names a departure airport, has no
   take-off time, did not fly more than 1,000 ft above that airport, and the
   same aircraft departs again from the same airport within 3 hours
   (10,800 s). **`superseded_arr`** is the mirror for arrivals: no landing
   time, and the same aircraft arrived at the same airport within the 3 hours
   before.
2. **`movement_dep`** is true when the row names a departure airport, is not
   superseded, and there is evidence that the aircraft flew: a take-off time,
   a destination airport, a crossing of a distance circle, a climb of more
   than 1,000 ft above the airport, or a last position more than 40 NM from
   it. **`movement_arr`** is the mirror for arrivals.
3. No row is removed: the columns let users count, and choose.

## Based on

Developed for OPDI.

## What is published

Flight list columns `superseded_dep`, `superseded_arr`, `movement_dep` and
`movement_arr` (true or false), together with `track_duration_min` (see
[First seen and last seen](first-last-seen.qmd)).

## Use cases

- **Daily departures and arrivals per airport**: count the rows with
  `movement_dep` (or `movement_arr`) true.
- **Compare with official counts**, keeping in mind that airports with little
  reception on the ground have fewer detected take-offs.

## Limitations

The rules have not been checked against reference counts, and the 3-hour
window can merge two real short flights of one aircraft. See
[Limitations: milestone columns](../limitations.qmd#lim-flight-list-milestones).

## Availability and accuracy

Every row has the four columns. Not validated against reference counts.
